_comment: Limits for diff.js. diffPercent is % of compared (unmasked) pixels that differ, per region name or kind (chrome is stricter than text). inkPercent is differing pixels / pixels that are ink in either image, per region. flatDeltaE is the CIE76 colour difference between a region's dominant colours (wrong greys). blurMae is the mean absolute error of blurred images, % of full scale. shadowError is RMSE in luminance levels. sizeDelta is the window size difference in CSS px. rowYOffset is the mean vertical offset of text rows in CSS px. Per-case entries in "cases" override the defaults key by key. These start loose so crude fixtures pass or fail meaningfully; tighten as the module improves.
